## Example 4.3 {#ss4-example-4-3 .ar-lesson }

Find the sum of the first fifty positive even numbers.

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 21 · Example 4.3</p>

::: notes

First term 2, last term 100, n=50. S_50=50(2+100)/2=2550. The first fifty even numbers do not stop at 50. Ask students how they identify the last term before substituting.

:::
